title: Just having fun
author: VegetableTour1920
selftext:
Just having plain old fun, "Random BS - go". Game prototype early stages. It has huge open world which this track is part of. Nice damage model with bending bodies. I'm still figuring stuff out, but so far I've found "traditional" weapons (MG, rockets .. quite dull during races). I'm leaning more into unhinged weapons. No weapons might be even more fun at the moment.   
    
There is a short campaign prototype where you start with a crap car which you can change or upgrade as the campaign progresses. Had fun trying out the multiplayer with my son. after that he's been asking to play it by himself - he likes to blow up the other cars with random stuff.
